messages:
Morgan: heads up — spotted a 404 in the runtime batching guide. link points to an old gist that was deleted: `https://gist.github.com/redwood/old-batch-examples`
Sam: I can pick this up. do we want the fix on `main` or backported to `release/1.2` as well? :hand:
Morgan: main + backport to `release/1.2` please. low-risk sed patch. also might be the same link in ja locale.
Taylor: yep, saw that in `docs/ja/runtime/batching.md` too. @Sam can you check the localized copy if you're touching it?
Sam: will do. quick plan: replace gist with internal page `/docs/examples/batching.md` and add a tiny changelog line.
Ben: i can preview the change on staging once the PR is up. tag me for a quick QA pass.
docs-bot: automated scan: found 1 additional occurrence matching the old gist URL in `docs/reference/batch.md`.
Sam: good catch — will update that file as well. patch will be a single commit: `sed -i 's|https://gist.github.com/redwood/old-batch-examples|/docs/examples/batching.md|g' $(git grep -l "old-batch-examples")`
Taylor: quick reminder — add a short note in the PR description about the ja backport and that codeowners doesn't need to change. otherwise i can review. :+1:
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes main + draft backport PR for `release/1.2`. pinging @Taylor for review, @Ben for staging preview.
Ben: previewed on staging, image render looks fine, no broken anchors.
Taylor: left a tiny nit on wording but LGTM for the link fix.
deploy-bot: staging build succeeded — build 2023-11-08T14:22:10Z.
Morgan: thanks all. will merge in ~2h if no objections.
Sam: merged main PR and backport is opened and queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1235. closing the thread after backport lands.
deploy-bot: backport build passed on `release/1.2` — build 2023-11-08T16:05:01Z.
Sam: backport merged. done. :tada:
Morgan: perfect, thanks everyone. saved a future customer confusion bug.
